bibl.title: The Abbasid Caliph al-Muqtadir Found on Papyrus Record.
bibl.seg: Khaled Younes, The Abbasid Caliph al-Muqtadir Found on Papyrus Record.
bibl.note: Edition of an Arabic papyrus fragment currently kept at the papyrus collection of the Austrian National Library (provenance unknown). The fragment contains only the name of the Abbasid caliph al-Muqtadir bi-llāh (r. 295-320 / 908-932) and part of the title amīr al-mu’minīn (the commander of the believers). Although too poor to afford any profitable historical discussion, the fragment remains important as it records the name of the caliph al-Muqtadir bi-llāh, whose long reign had unfortunately left very little documentary evidence on papyrus.
